sloka: सीता तृतीयान् आरूढान् दृष्ट्वा धृष्टम् अचोदयत् ।सुमन्त्रः सम्मतान् अश्वान् वायु वेग समान् जवे ॥२-४०-१७॥
transliteration: sītā tṛtīyān ārūḍhān dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭam acodayat ।sumantraḥ sammatān aśvān vāyu vega samān jave ॥2-40-17॥

translations.english: So also Dasaratha secured a multitude of weapons, shields and protective leathercoverings for hands and placed them at the centre of the chariot, for use by the brothers. When Sumantra ensured that Sita, Rama and Lakshmana boarded the chariot, he briskly hastened the horses which were as speedy as the wind.
translations.hindi: राह चलते मनुष्यों के भी नेत्र आँसुओं से {भरे हुए थे, कहीं ' असन्नता का नाम तक न था, क्योंकि सब के सब पुरवासी शोक- -सन्तप्त हो रहे थे
